name: LookAway
soft_passes: #1 mask: reads squircle-native but bakes in its own gold specular rim and is delivered pre-masked (HIG says provide unmasked square + let system apply specular); corner is a continuous-rounded superellipse, slightly rounder than classic Big Sur
#10 variant robustness: composition survives tint/mono (meaning rides eye-arcs + blob shape) but as a baked raster it ships no true Icon Composer default/dark/clear/tinted variants
failures: #3 silhouette: filled solid black the contour is an un-nameable pebble and the dark eyes merge away — identity lives in interior negative-space eye-arcs, not contour (recovers under grayscale/luminance and 16px squint via strong blob-on-black figure-ground)

palette.background: near-flat black #000000->#151515 (faint ambient glow under blob)

light_model: single warm environmental light from upper-right; bronze/gold specular rim on top squircle edge (brightest upper-right #634E30); emissive self-luminous gradient core rather than lit object; soft ambient bloom beneath, no hard cast shadow
layer_stack: warm specular rim on squircle edge
devices: closed-eyes rest-face (two upturned arcs = peaceful/sleeping eyes; literal 'look away and rest')
emissive gradient orb (self-luminous pink->peach pebble on black, no outline)
warm specular rim (single bronze/gold top-edge light-catch)
rhymes_hint: dark-field emissive-orb wellness/mindfulness icons (glowing gradient blob on black, meaning carried by glow + minimal face) — rhymes with meditation/breathing/AI-assistant 'orb' icons more than any productivity-tool icon; candidate 'emissive-orb / soft-wellness' cluster, unconfirmed (first icon in corpus)
notes: Resolution: 256x256 web render (downsized, likely from 1024) — fine specular/refraction detail and true glass layering not assessable; mild gradient banding from downscale. Baked raster, NOT Icon Composer-authored: gold rim + glow are baked in against HIG (system should apply specular; ships no light/dark/clear/tinted variants). Era classified liquid-glass on VISUAL LANGUAGE (warm specular rim, translucent emissive core, dark-mode-native field) though structurally it is a single front plane quoting the era, not a layered glass stack. Glyph_type marked 'abstract' but reads as a minimal mascot-face. Strong brand coherence: cover's timer-notification glyph reuses the same magenta->gold ramp; icon == hero app icon in cover. For SYNTHESIS: the load-bearing learning is the silhouette/luminance tradeoff — emissive-orb icons deliberately forgo contour-nameability and win at Dock/Spotlight through figure-ground glow instead; verify whether that is a defensible cluster convention against >=2 more dark-glow icons.
